domain: College Sports Team and Player Management
scenario:
A collegiate sports association is developing an enterprise-level Sports Team and Player Management System to efficiently manage and analyze sports teams and player data across various academic institutions. This system facilitates detailed tracking of team rosters, player statistics, and performance metrics for multiple sports seasons.

The platform should allow colleges to maintain comprehensive records of teams, including information about each team's roster, player profiles, and their historical performance data. It should provide detailed player statistics such as position, height, class year, games played, and games started. Additionally, the system should manage data on player progression across different academic years and track changes in team compositions.

Advanced features include generating performance analytics, comparing player statistics across teams, and integrating with external player profile links. The system will support role-based access control, enabling coaches, sports analysts, and administrators to access relevant data while maintaining data security and integrity.

The goal is to provide an all-encompassing solution for managing collegiate sports data, improving team management efficiency, and enhancing decision-making processes through data-driven insights.
